sentences.text:
Pradip Kowar @ Koner vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 3
February, 2026
03.02.2026

Item No.40
Sudipta
 Crr 466 of 2025
 Pradip Kowar @ Koner
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Navanil De
 Mr. Srinjan Ghosh
 ...for the petitioner.

1. 
The revisional application has been preferred by the de facto complainant challenging an order
dated December 05, 2024 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Purba Burdwan in Criminal Misc.
Case No.1543 of 2023 thereby allowing the application for transfer filed by the opposite party no.1
under Section 408 of the Code of Criminal Procedure praying for withdrawal and transfer of Katwa
Police Station Case No. 991 of 2022 dated December 14, 2022 under Sections 498A / 306 / 304B /
34 of the Ipc read with Sections 3 /4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act corresponding to G.R. Case No.
1692 of 2022 giving rise to Sessions Case 48 of 2024 from the Court of learned Additional Sessions
Judge, Katwa to the Court of the learned Judge, Fast Track Court cum learned Additional Sessions
Judge, Kalna.

2.  Considering the nature of relief prayed for, the revision is required to be heard in presence of the opposite parties.
3.
The petitioner to serve upon the opposite parties.
Affidavit of service be filed before the Regular Bench.

4. Pending hearing of the revisional application, the proceedings in Criminal Misc. Case No.1543 of 2023 pending before the Court of the learned Judge, Fast Track Court cum learned Additional Sessions Judge, Kalna be stayed till 21st April, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.

[ Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. ]
